source.code:
/-- `vecCons h t` prepends an entry `h` to a vector `t`.

The inverse functions are `vecHead` and `vecTail`.
The notation `![a, b, ...]` expands to `vecCons a (vecCons b ...)`.
-/
def vecCons {n : ℕ} (h : α) (t : Fin n → α) : Fin n.succ → α :=
  Fin.cons h t
